decisions.reason: The coffee-based men's series builds on the firm's long experience formulating certified natural cosmetics, so it can still interpret and improve the line, but it targets a new customer segment where the firm has less market knowledge, which makes it the riskier of the two.

The cleansing foam is a direct extension of the established Sandorini series and draws fully on existing formulation and customer knowledge, so the firm can readily assimilate feedback and has little reason to withdraw it.
